narrative.coaching_note: Lávese con agua y jabón antes de tocar a resident A a los 55.2 segundos, porque el alcohol no elimina las esporas de C. difficile. Usted tocó bed rail A con gloved hand a los 22 segundos y esa contaminación pasó a call button a los 26.3 segundos. Usted usó alcohol en sanitizer bottle a los 0.2, 32.3 y 64.1 segundos, pero ese producto no mata estas esporas, por eso necesita agua y jabón. La próxima vez, lávese con agua y jabón antes de ponerse los guantes y después de quitárselos. Este cambio protege a resident A antes del contacto y evita llevar lo de bed rail A y call button a sus manos. Recuerde que sus manos quedaron contaminadas al final junto con bed rail A y call button.
narrative.audit_summary: Source was bed rail A with C. difficile spores. Transfer chain was bed rail A to gloved hand at 22 seconds to call button at 26.3 seconds; no resident exposures occurred. One WHO opportunity occurred: Moment 1 before touching resident A at 55.2 seconds, compliance 0 of 1, overall 0 of 1. Three alcohol rubs at 0.2, 32.3, and 64.1 seconds met WHO duration at 21.8, 22.9, and 24.2 seconds but were not effective against this pathogen, as alcohol rub does not kill spores and soap and water is required. Glove practice showed no effective hygiene after doffing at 32.3 seconds and before donning at 54.8 seconds. Disinfect call button and bed rail A with an EPA List K sporicidal disinfectant.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was performing hand hygiene for Moment 1 before touching resident A at 55.2 seconds.
